### Description

<!-- Please insert your description here and provide especially info about the "what" this PR is solving -->

This PR goes ahead and resolves the issue over at https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/9003, and it additionally closes the pull request over at https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/pull/9047, which it supersedes and takes the place of.

<!-- You can also add additional context here -->

### Please don't delete this checklist! Before submitting the PR, please make sure you do the following:
- [x] It's really quite useful if your PR happens to reference an issue somewhere, one where it is discussed ahead of time in advance. If the feature is a substantial one, or if it goes and introduces breaking changes of some kind without any discussion first, then the PR might well end up being closed on you.
- [x] Ideally, what you should go and do is to include a test, specifically one that fails without this PR being in place but then goes on to pass once it actually is.
- [ ] Please, do not go and make any changes at all to the `pnpm-lock.yaml` file, unless it happens to be the case that you are also introducing a brand new test example along with it.
- [ ] Please go ahead and check the [Allow edits by maintainers](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/collaborating-with-pull-requests/working-with-forks/allowing-changes-to-a-pull-request-branch-created-from-a-fork) option, so as to help make the whole review process go faster than it would. Do note that this particular option is not one that is available for any of the repositories that happen to be owned by Github organizations.

### Tests
- [ ] Go ahead and run the whole set of tests, doing so by way of the `pnpm test:ci` command.

### Documentation
- [ ] If you happen to introduce any new functionality, then do go ahead and document it (you are able to run the documentation with the `pnpm run docs` command).

### Changesets
- [x] The changes over in the changelog are the ones generated automatically from the PR name. Please, do make very sure that it explains your changes in a manner that is understandable, and please do prefix each of the changeset messages with `feat:`, `fix:`, `perf:`, `docs:`, or else `chore:`.

 import assert from 'node:assert'
 import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
-import { existsSync } from 'node:fs'
+import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
 import { copyFile, mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
+import path from 'node:path'
 import { isPrimitive } from '@vitest/utils/helpers'
 import { serializeValue } from '@vitest/utils/serialize'
 import { parseErrorStacktrace } from '@vitest/utils/source-map'
+import convertSourceMap from 'convert-source-map'
 import mime from 'mime/lite'
 import { basename, extname, resolve } from 'pathe'
 
@@ -170,6 +173,18 @@ export class TestRun {
         else {
           error.stacks = parseErrorStacktrace(error, {
             frameFilter: project.config.onStackTrace,
+            getSourceMap(file) {
+              // This only handles external modules since
+              // source map is already applied for inlined modules.
+              // Module node exists due to Vitest fetch module,
+              // but transformResult should be empty for external modules.
+              const mod = project.vite.moduleGraph.getModuleById(file)
+              if (!mod?.transformResult && existsSync(file)) {
+                const code = readFileSync(file, 'utf-8')
+                const result = extractSourcemapFromFile(code, file)
+                return result
+              }
+            },
           })
         }
       })
@@ -298,3 +313,31 @@ function sanitizeFilePath(s: string): string {
   // eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex
   return s.replace(/[\x00-\x2C\x2E\x2F\x3A-\x40\x5B-\x60\x7B-\x7F]+/g, '-')
 }
+
+// based on vite
+// https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/84079a84ad94de4c1ef4f1bdb2ab448ff2c01196/packages/vite/src/node/server/sourcemap.ts#L149
+function extractSourcemapFromFile(
+  code: string,
+  filePath: string,
+): SourceMap | undefined {
+  const map = (
+    convertSourceMap.fromSource(code)
+    || (convertSourceMap.fromMapFileSource(
+      code,
+      createConvertSourceMapReadMap(filePath),
+    ))
+  )?.toObject()
+  return map
+}
+
+function createConvertSourceMapReadMap(originalFileName: string) {
+  return (filename: string) => {
+    // convertSourceMap can detect invalid filename from comments.
+    // fallback to empty source map to avoid errors.
+    const targetPath = path.resolve(path.dirname(originalFileName), filename)
+    if (existsSync(targetPath)) {
+      return readFileSync(targetPath, 'utf-8')
+    }
+    return '{}'
+  }
+}
